abstraction.description: MITRE's level of the entry, such as Pillar, Class, Base or Variant. May be empty.

status.description: MITRE's status of the entry, such as Stable, Draft or Incomplete. May be empty.

likelihood_of_exploit.description: High, Medium, Low or Unknown. Empty when MITRE gives none.

examples.description: Each is a reference, usually a CVE ID, then ": " and a note when MITRE gives one.

parent_cwe.description: Empty when the CWE has no parent.

owasp_top10.description: OWASP Top 10 categories naming this CWE, oldest edition first. Empty: none. null: mapping not loaded.

cve_count.description: CVEs with this CWE, rejected ones included.

kev_count.description: CVEs with this CWE that are in CISA KEV, rejected ones included.

avg_cvss.description: Mean CVSS v3 score of the CVEs with this CWE that have one. null when none has one.

avg_epss.description: Mean EPSS of its scored CVEs. null if none is scored or the mean rounds to 0.0000.

updated_at.description: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ when the CWE sync last wrote this record. Empty when unknown.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
